subject: Acme cloud compliance: KMS ownership mapping & timestamped rotation logs
messages:
From: Lina Soto <lina.soto@acme-cloud.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: security@acme-cloud.com
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: KMS key ownership mapping + timestamped rotation logs

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking this. As part of Acme Cloud's SIG intake we need a compact artifact set demonstrating how Redwood manages key ownership and rotation for customer data keys. Specifically we need: 1) a table mapping logical key IDs to the owning service/team and the KMS (e.g., Cloud KMS, HSM-backed) 2) timestamped rotation logs (who rotated, which key version, and prior key fingerprint) for the last 12 months 3) the latest HSM attestation summary if keys are HSM-protected.

We don't need raw private key material — just metadata and signed attestations. Can you confirm what you can provide and a target delivery date?

Cheers,
Lina Soto
Security Engineer, Acme Cloud

--
Attachment: SIG_request_form.pdf (pdf stub)
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Lina Soto <lina.soto@acme-cloud.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: KMS key ownership mapping + timestamped rotation logs

Hi Lina — thanks for the clear list. Short answer: we can provide all three items in the form you describe (mapping CSV, rotation ledger export, and HSM attestation summary).

Plan/owners:
- I will own the mapping CSV and deliver a key->service mapping with key classes (customer-data vs internal) and which KMS/cluster the key resides in.
- Monica will prepare the rotation ledger (CSV export from our key-management service with timestamps and operator IDs).
- Marissa will attach the latest HSM attestation PDF (she manages the HSM/infra attestations).

Target delivery: EOD Friday (2026-08-06) if that works. If you need earlier, tell me which item to prioritize.

We will redact any operator credentials and only provide fingerprints for prior keys. We will also include a short readme describing our rotation policy and retention window.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Sr. Security PM, Redwood Inference
From: Lina Soto <lina.soto@acme-cloud.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 07:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: KMS key ownership mapping + timestamped rotation logs

Thanks Jonas — EOD Friday is fine. A couple of quick clarifications:
1) For mapping CSV, can you include the key lifecycle state (active/disabled/deleted) and any customer-facing alias?
2) For rotation ledger, we need ISO8601 timestamps and the type of rotation (automatic vs manual).
3) If any keys are BYOK, please mark them and include the handshake artifact ID.

If you include those columns it will speed up Acme's SIG review.

Lina
From: monica.patel@redwood.com
To: Lina Soto <lina.soto@acme-cloud.com>, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2026 16:24:00 -0700
Subject: Deliverables: KMS mapping + rotation ledger + HSM attestation (Acme)

Hi Lina — attached are the artifacts per Jonas's plan. Quick notes inline.

Attachments:
- kms_key_ownership_map_20260806.csv (columns: key_id, alias, owner_service, owner_team, kms_type, lifecycle_state, byok_flag, handshake_id)
- rotation-ledger-2025-2026.csv (columns: timestamp_iso8601, key_id, rotation_type, actor, old_fingerprint, new_fingerprint, ticket_id)
- hsm_attestation-summary-2026-06.pdf (HSM vendor attestation summary, redacted serials)

Summary:
- All customer-data keys are in Cloud KMS clusters with HSM-backed key-protect. BYOK keys are marked in the map; handshake IDs reference our BYOK onboarding ticket.
- Rotation ledger includes automatic scheduled rotations and manual emergency key rotations; manual rotations include an associated ticket id where operator justification is recorded.
- The HSM attestation is a vendor-signed summary; we have included the attestation signature block and the attestation validity window. Full hardware serials were redacted per our vendor agreement; if Acme needs unredacted serials we can route a CNDA.

Please confirm receipt and we can walk through any rows you'd like to inspect.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Security Operations, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: kms_key_ownership_map_20260806.csv (csv stub)
Attachment: rotation-ledger-2025-2026.csv (csv stub)
Attachment: hsm_attestation-summary-2026-06.pdf (pdf stub)
From: Lina Soto <lina.soto@acme-cloud.com>
To: monica.patel@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: security@acme-cloud.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 16:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deliverables: KMS mapping + rotation ledger + HSM attestation (Acme)

Monica/Jonas — received everything and thanks for the fast turnaround. A few follow-ups from our intake team after a quick pass:
- The rotation ledger looks good; can you confirm retention policy for the ledger itself (how long Redwood keeps rotation logs)?
- On the mapping CSV some aliases map to a shared key used across multiple services. Can you add a column describing any cross-tenant or cross-service sharing and whether the key is scoped to a single tenant?
- For the HSM attestation: Acme's procurement requires the attestation chain. If you can provide the vendor attestation chain reference or a pointer to the signed cert bundle that would be ideal. If CNDA required, we can start that flow.

If you prefer a short 20-minute call to triage these items, my calendar is open tomorrow morning.

Best,
Lina Soto
Security Engineer, Acme Cloud
